_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Akɔnkye Snake wɔ {width}×{height} pɔwboard so.
Wɔyɛ akɔnkyeni {player_id}. Sɛnkyerɛmdeɛ a wɔtumi yɛ: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (anaa w/s/a/d).
Botaeɛ: di akɔnkye no mu kyɛm sene wɔn a wɔwɔ hɔ no anaasɛ wɔyɛ akɔnkyeni a wɔtɔ so kyɛm sen wɔn a wɔwɔ hɔ no na wɔnya akɔnkye no mu nsɛm kɛseɛ (sɛnkyerɛmdeɛ {max_turns} sɛnkyerɛmdeɛ).

board.after_moves: Ɔman a wɔhwɛ so ma wɔn no: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Oguan {player_id} wui esiane sɛ na ne nsa nni hɔ nti.

outcome.survived_win: Ɔbɔadeɛ {player_id} nyaa nkwa; wɔn a aka no nyinaa wui.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Wɔmaa awɔ no nyinaa wuwui bere koro mu.
outcome.outlived: Ɔbɔfo no traa ase sen afoforo nyinaa.
outcome.turn_limit: Sɛ wudu baabi a ɛsɛ sɛ wohyere no - nea ɔwɔ akatua pa sen biara di nkonim wɔ tie-break mu.
outcome.ranking: {reason} Akɔnkye no mu nsɛm a wɔde kyerɛɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ no (bɔne sen kɛseɛ): {groups}
